messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I have a question regarding the use of MSstats for protein analysis of DIA data processed with Spectronaut.

I downloaded the TSV file named "_Report_MSstats Report (v3.7.3) (Normal)" from Spectronaut after disabling the cross-run normalization option in the Quantification settings. I then imported the file into R and converted it using:
msstats_input <- SpectronauttoMSstatsFormat(...)

The resulting msstats_input.csv file contains the following columns:

colnames(msstats_input)
[1] "ProteinName" "PeptideSequence" "PrecursorCharge" "FragmentIon" [5] "ProductCharge" "IsotopeLabelType" "Condition" "BioReplicate" [9] "Run" "Fraction" "Intensity"

However, when I attempt to upload this file into MSstatsShiny, I receive the following error message:
>
> Failed to load data: The following columns are missing from the input data: FGCharge.

Should I select "MSstats Format" as the Type of File when importing the data instead? If so, is this option intended only for data generated from Spectronaut, or should the MSstats Format option be used for any dataset that has been converted with the MSstatsConvert package, regardless of the original software platform?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Luisa Maria
